summary: A clean, active React wrapper with good types and React 18/19 support, but it depends on lottie-web 5.13.0, which has not shipped since May 2025 and contains eval in the browser bundle. It is JSON-only. Keep it as a legacy JSON fallback and replace it with @lottiefiles/dotlottie-react for new work.
reasoning: The wrapper itself is active: 3.1.2 published 2026-09-07; repository pushed 2026-09-07; six open issues.
Peers React ^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0, and a React 19 spike rendered the JSON animation in 56 ms with SVG output.
MIT, bundled types, one runtime dependency, and no install scripts.

The runtime dependency is lottie-web ^5.13.0, whose latest release is May 2025 and whose repository has been quiet since September 2025. The chosen stack therefore fails the 12-month active-maintenance constraint.
The Vite production build warned about eval() inside lottie-web, which is a CSP and code-quality concern.
No npm provenance and no .lottie support. The wrapper is a JSON-only path.
caveats: Inherits lottie-web's stale release cadence and eval usage.
No npm provenance. Pin 3.1.2 and record the gap if it is kept as a legacy fallback.
The bundle was 521.17 KB / 145.52 KB gzip including React 19; lottie-web is the bulk of it.
The wrapper is active, but a wrapper cannot fix the runtime underneath it.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT. The isolated tree is React, React DOM, lottie-react and lottie-web, all MIT.

evidence.label: React compatibility
evidence.detail: peerDependencies react: ^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0. The spike used React 19.2.0 and rendered SVG.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: One runtime dependency, lottie-web ^5.13.0; 33 MB installed with React; 358 KB unpacked for the wrapper.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script in the isolated tree.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: OSV returned no advisories for lottie-react@3.1.2 or lottie-web@5.13.0.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: The wrapper is active, but its required runtime lottie-web has not shipped since 2025-05-21 (more than 12 months) and the lottie-web repository was last pushed 2025-09-01. The chosen stack fails the active-maintenance constraint.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: No npm attestation for lottie-react@3.1.2 or lottie-web@5.13.0.

evidence.label: React browser spike
evidence.detail: A Vite production build rendered the JSON animation as SVG in Chrome 1200x800. The component reached SVG output in 56 ms. The bundle was 521.17 KB / 145.52 KB gzip including React 19.

evidence.label: CSP and eval
evidence.detail: Vite warned that lottie-web uses eval() in the browser bundle. This is a CSP and code-quality concern for a new integration.
